incident-bot: PAGING: Metering anomaly detected — token_count drift between emitter and aggregator for prod (svc: metering-emit). Alert id: MET-2026-3492. See /incidents/3623456789
alice (oncall): On it — joining. What's the customer scope? Any overage flags firing?
carla (sre): joining the thread. Observed elevated delta in the rolling 5m window. Not a full outage but counts diverging. ETA to debug 5m.
dinesh (billing-eng): quick summary: emitter is emitting duplicate ACKs for a subset of requests due to retry logic combining with a new batching change. Aggregator dedup path missed an id pattern. Initial diff: ~+4.8% tokens in last hour. Sample log lines:
```
2026-03-17T20:03:12Z emitter id=svc-emit-4 request_id=xyz token_count=120
2026-03-17T20:03:12Z aggregator id=agg-2 request_id=xyz NOT_DEDUPED
```
carla (sre): ok — mitigation plan: 1) pause emitter downstream batching (hotfix toggle), 2) enable aggregator strict dedup, 3) start targeted replay backfill with corrected ids. Will coordinate.
alice (oncall): dinesh, can you flip the emitter toggle? If not, we revert to emitter v1. Make sure we don't disrupt latency SLA.
dinesh (billing-eng): flipping toggle now -> /api/feature-toggles/metering-batch false
devops-bot: deploy started: metering-emitter v2026.03.17-hotfix -> 3 nodes. CI: passed. Trace: https://ci/repo/1234
carla (sre): aggregator dedup rule applied (rule id: dedup-2026-03-17-1). Monitoring for negative regressions.
eva (cust-success): flagged two mid-market customers seeing overage emails — accounts: ACCT-RED-001, ACCT-BLU-119. Investigating outreach. They reported invoices with unexpected token bumps.
dinesh (billing-eng): running live recon now. Preliminary: inflight window produced double-counts for requests with missing epk header. Backfill queued for 02:00AM UTC; will run incremental fix for affected windows.
alice (oncall): good. Any immediate actions for CS? Suggested customer message: short apology, investigating, no billing charges will be finalized until reconciliation completes.
eva (cust-success): sending templated note to impacted accounts now :email: — will hold immediate charge adjustments until confirm. Triage owner?
carla (sre): triage owner: dinesh. Oncall remains alice for paging. I'll monitor metrics for 30m after fix.
dinesh (billing-eng): recon run finished (sample). Summary: fixed 78% of dupes with new rule. Remaining ~1.1% residual — investigating root id generation race. Preparing patch for aggregator id normalization.
alice (oncall): nice work. Marking incident as active -> mitigation in progress. Will escalate if residual > 2% after 60m.
eva (cust-success): customers notified, CS tickets created (#CS-7421, #CS-7423). Will coordinate credits if final reconciliation shows overcharge.
carla (sre): monitoring dashboard: token-diff back to baseline (~0.2%) — no further pages. Closing paging loop in 30m unless we see reoccurrence.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: MET-2026-3492 mitigation applied. Status: monitoring. Links: runbook://metering-drift, playbook://billing-reconcile
alice (oncall): closing thread once dev patch merges and postmortem (short) created. Thanks all :thumbsup:
